bootstrap.unit: Image; both CFA phases clustered, fixed dataset sizes stratified; cohorts separate

scope: Stored rendered uint8RGB, remosaiced at native resolution; no inverse gamma or resize. Inset16 crops each reference before remosaicing.
publication_notes: Per-scene deltas omitted from this compact report; derive them from the complete compressed rows with benchmark/summarize_softmenon_quality.py.
The measured binaries are hash-pinned in adjacent metadata. Later exact implementation changes require a complete output-hash verification against these rows.
The same corpus was used for exploratory selection and reporting; bootstrap intervals describe this corpus and do not establish an independent held-out generalization estimate.
